_comment_strategy: AREA 0 — same as register-file flow; compute logic unchanged
_comment_macros: 8 SRAM macros for 256-bit-wide × 512-deep weight memory. Paths are inside the Docker container's volare cache (mounted from host).
_comment_blackbox: Yosys auto-blackboxes the SRAM via its empty-body stub in VERILOG_FILES
_comment_layers: RT_MIN_LAYER/RT_MAX_LAYER forces BOTH signal and clock routing to met3+ via set_routing_layers. DRT_MIN_LAYER (wrong variable — only affects clock in OL2) replaced with RT_MIN_LAYER.
_comment_grt_throttle: Block li1/met1/met2 (indices 0-2) so router stays on met3+. Format: List[Decimal] in layer order li1,met1,met2,met3,met4,met5.
_comment_macro_extension: Pad SRAM macro boundaries with extra GCells of routing exclusion
_comment_placement: Manual SRAM placement — 4×2 grid in lower-left quadrant, leaves rest for compute
_comment_floorplan: Generous die (3600x3600 µm). Macros take ~1.5 mm² of total ~13 mm² die.
